property_summary: For any admissible input where the call does not revert, the reference always returns true, while the mutant always returns false, so the return value equality rule is violated by the mutant.
For any successful call, the transfer function of the reference contract never returns false, while the buggy contract can return true even when some internal transferFrom calls fail.
For any combination of addresses where the caddress is a contract that causes the transferFrom call to fail, the reference function reverts, while the buggy version does not revert and returns true.
For any call to transfer where caddress is a contract that fails on at least one transferFrom sub-call, the reference C always reverts, while the buggy M never reverts and returns true.
